_comment: Dataset catalog. Counts are SOURCE-REPORTED unless marked 'audited'. Do not sum counts across records: several overlap (noted in known_overlap). Acquisition metadata checked against publisher APIs on 2026-10-23; subset-capable records (acquisition.subset) and their counts checked on 2026-10-24.

records.name: BTXRD: Bone Tumor X-ray Radiograph dataset
records.summary: First milestone dataset. Radiographs with image-level labels, tumor boxes/masks and clinical fields.

counts.patients: unknown: release has no patient or lesion id

labels.annotation_format: LabelMe 5.4.1 JSON, one file per tumor image
labels.reference_standard: paper reports histology or confirmation by two radiology experts, with pathology absent for some images; per-image confirmation method remains unresolved (primary paper reviewed 2026-10-24)

unresolved: patient grouping: dataset.xlsx has no patient or lesion id, and the paper says several views can show the same lesion
device per image (center and anatomic site are in dataset.xlsx)
label errors: 2 byte-identical image pairs are labeled benign in one copy and normal in the other (IMG000591/IMG003456, IMG000707/IMG003346); 21 exact-duplicate pairs in total
overlap with other public bone X-ray sets

records.name: BreastMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: Breast ultrasound, benign+normal vs malignant, preprocessed to small npz arrays. Good for fast pipeline tests.
unresolved: MedMNIST splits may not respect patient grouping of the source dataset
records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2, Scientific Data 2023; data doi:10.5281/zenodo.10519652; source: Al-Dhabyani et al. 2020

records.name: PathMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: Colorectal cancer histology tiles, 9 tissue classes (from NCT-CRC-HE-100K / CRC-VAL-HE-7K). 28px and 64px versions.
unresolved: tiles from the same slide/patient cannot be grouped from the npz alone
records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Kather et al. 2019 (NCT-CRC-HE)

records.name: NoduleMNIST3D (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: 3D lung nodule crops from LIDC-IDRI with benign/malignant labels derived from radiologist suspicion ratings (not pathology).

labels.reference_standard: radiologist malignancy ratings, not confirmed diagnosis

records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Armato et al. 2011 (LIDC-IDRI)

records.name: LIDC-IDRI sample (3 CT series, more patients on request)
records.summary: Three pinned CT series for adapter smoke tests and DICOM ingestion; add whole patients' CT series as a seeded sample or by patient ID. Not an evaluation set: LIDC is in the MONAI lung bundle's training data.

counts.status: from TCIA API metadata; collection counts 2026-10-24

labels.note: Radiologist XML annotations are distributed separately on TCIA and are not included.

records.name: DermaMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
records.summary: Dermatoscopic images from HAM10000, 7 diagnostic classes.
unresolved: HAM10000 has multiple images per lesion; MedMNIST split may leak lesions across partitions
records.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Tschandl et al. 2018 (HAM10000)

records.name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task01 BrainTumour
records.summary: Multimodal brain MRI (FLAIR, T1w, T1gd, T2w) with tumor sub-region labels, derived from BraTS 2016/2017. For brain adapter testing only: overlaps BraTS 2018 training data of the MONAI bundle.

labels.note: Label convention differs from the BraTS 2018 bundle's TC/WT/ET outputs; map explicitly.

records.citation: Antonelli et al. 2022, The Medical Segmentation Decathlon, Nat Commun

records.name: MURA musculoskeletal radiographs
records.summary: Normal/abnormal upper-extremity studies. Abnormal is not cancer; possible representation/robustness research only.

acquisition.instructions: Register at https://stanfordmlgroup.github.io/competitions/mura/ and accept the research use agreement yourself; place files in data/mura/ and write a PROVENANCE.json.

records.name: LIDC-IDRI (full)
records.summary: 1,010 subjects / 244,527 DICOM images (~133 GB per archive). Suspicion ratings are not confirmed malignancy.

acquisition.instructions: Too large to fetch whole here (about 128 GB of CT series alone). Fetch a subset of patients through lidc-idri-sample, or use the NBIA Data Retriever on the big machine.

records.name: BraTS 2021 challenge data
records.summary: Brain tumor MRI segmentation challenge release; partitions and labels are release-specific.

acquisition.instructions: Requires Synapse registration and challenge terms; obtain it yourself. Check overlap with BraTS 2018 and MSD before evaluating any bundle.

records.name: PANDA prostate biopsy challenge
records.summary: 10,616 biopsies / 2,113 patients (published dev set). Group by patient.

acquisition.instructions: Kaggle competition data (hundreds of GB). Big machine only, after accepting Kaggle rules yourself.

records.name: CAMELYON16
records.summary: Lymph-node whole-slide images for metastasis research, fetched slide by slide from the public AWS bucket (about 1.9 GB per slide on average). Check encoder pretraining overlap.

labels.region_level: tumor annotations (ASAP XML) for tumor and some test slides
labels.note: Test-slide labels are in evaluation/reference.csv, fetched with every subset

unresolved: patient linkage between slides is not published; each slide is treated as its own group
the README lists 20 tumor slides whose annotations are not exhaustive

license.notes: license.txt in the bucket (read 2026-10-24) says CC0; some challenge pages cite CC BY-NC-ND 4.0

records.name: ISIC Archive
records.summary: Skin lesion images across many collections, fetched through the ISIC API v2 for a search you narrow (e.g. diagnosis_3:"Melanoma, NOS"). Only CC-0 and CC-BY images are offered; each image comes with its API metadata record.

labels.image_level: diagnosis_1..5 hierarchy plus diagnosis_confirm_type; varies by collection

unresolved: patient_id/lesion_id are missing for many images; those images are treated as their own group, so same-patient images can still be split apart
images recur across ISIC challenge releases and HAM10000 (DermaMNIST)
the API's file sizes can lag the served image (ISIC_0911264, 2026-10-24) and there is no published checksum, so images are hashed on arrival (trust on first use)

license.id: per-image (CC-0 / CC-BY; CC-BY-NC excluded by the fetcher)
license.notes: CC-BY attribution is in each image's metadata record

records.name: TCGA (via GDC)
records.summary: 33 cancer types; molecular, clinical and slide data. Open vs controlled access differ.

labels.note: Pick processed open-access files for a defined question

acquisition.instructions: Query the GDC API for open-access processed files for one project; never request controlled data without approval. TCGA-SARC slides are fetchable as a subset through tcga-sarc-slides.

records.name: TCGA-SARC whole-slide images (GDC open access)
records.summary: Sarcoma H&E slides (SVS) from the GDC, fetched case by case with publisher MD5s. Soft-tissue sarcoma, not primary bone tumors. About 1.2 GB per slide on average.

labels.note: Slides only. Histologic type and clinical data are separate GDC records and are not fetched.

unresolved: Diagnostic (FFPE) and Tissue (frozen) slides are mixed; pick by file name to restrict
many pathology foundation models were pretrained on TCGA slides; check encoder overlap before evaluating

license.notes: open tier only; terms not reviewed yet

records.citation: TCGA Research Network, Cell 2017 (adult soft tissue sarcomas); https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/TCGA-SARC

records.name: Soft-tissue-Sarcoma (TCIA): FDG-PET/CT and MRI
records.summary: Extremity soft-tissue sarcoma patients with CT, MR, PET and RT structure sets; fetch whole patients as a seeded sample or by ID (about 190 MB per patient, uncompressed). Not primary bone tumors.

labels.patient_level: clinical/INFOclinical_STS.xlsx from the collection page (sheets 'Clinical Information' and 'Outcome vector'): histology, grade, treatment, metastasis and survival follow-up; its 51 STS_xxx IDs match the TCIA PatientIDs
labels.note: The clinical spreadsheet is fetched with every subset; its outcome columns have not been reviewed.

unresolved: ROI names inside the RTSTRUCT series have not been reviewed
outcome labels in INFOclinical_STS.xlsx and their reference standard not reviewed

records.name: CBIS-DDSM mammography (TCIA)
records.summary: Curated DDSM screening mammograms with ROI crops and masks; fetch whole patients as a seeded sample or by ID. 163 GB in total, so only subsets fit here.

counts.status: from TCIA API metadata and the description CSVs, 2026-10-24. Patient grouping verified: the collection page says each participant has several patient IDs (6,671 IDs, 1,566 participants), and the CSVs' patient_id column holds exactly the 1,566 P_xxxxx values the group regex extracts

labels.lesion_level: labels/*_case_description_*.csv from the collection page: 3,568 abnormality rows (calc train 1,546, calc test 326, mass train 1,318, mass test 378) with pathology MALIGNANT / BENIGN / BENIGN_WITHOUT_CALLBACK, BI-RADS assessment, density, subtlety and the DICOM paths of each image, crop and mask
labels.note: Fetched with every subset. The official train/test split was made separately for mass and calcification cases, so 31 participants have rows in both a train and a test file.

unresolved: pathology reference standard per row not reviewed
31 participants cross the official mass/calc train/test split; a patient-level split must regroup them
